capabilities: Render progress bars from Markdown code blocks
Increment and decrement bar values with clickable buttons
Customize bar width, labels, button text, and step size
Format value labels with custom templates and percentage placeholders
disambiguation: Not a habit or task tracker; it only renders standalone progress bar blocks, not linked task completion.
extras: The author states it is experimental and their first Obsidian plugin and asks for feedback; the README links to a separate Properties Page for full customization details.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display or interactively adjust progress values inside a note.
summary: Progress bar renderer that creates customizable, interactive progress bars in notes via Markdown code blocks with increment/decrement buttons.
